evals.prompt: Make this Slack/Teams pastable. Use announcement.md exactly as written. Give me a local HTML page with separate copy buttons; do not open a browser or send it.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained local HTML with Slack-native and Teams-HTML clipboard paths, preserving the nested list and release link.
expectations: The output is a self-contained HTML page with separate Slack and Teams copy buttons.
The message wording, nested lists, and release link are preserved.
The response provides a preview path and does not claim destination rendering has been verified.
Slack copy supplies native slack/texty with three list levels rather than relying on HTML or plain-text markup.

evals.prompt: Format notes.md for Teams. The Internal notes section and Before you send checklist are part of my actual message, so keep them. Preserve the words. Give me a local copy-ready page without sending or opening anything.
evals.expected_output: A local Teams-ready preview that preserves the legitimate notes and review labels, with no EOD-specific filtering.
expectations: Internal notes, Before you send, Reviewer: Pat, and the checklist URL are retained.
The output is a local HTML page with a rich-HTML Teams copy button.
No EOD-specific filtering or inferred styles change the supplied message.
